title: Targeted synthetic data generation for tabular data
summary: An MSc thesis project that builds a targeted data-augmentation pipeline, using KNN Shapley-based data valuation to identify the hardest training points in a large American Express credit-default dataset before generating synthetic replacements for them. The pipeline directly instantiates SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and TVAESynthesizer (with SingleTableMetadata) and the standalone ctgan package's CTGAN/TVAE classes to fit and sample synthetic data for augmentation experiments.
